It has no qualified Treasury role.

unambiguous selected upstream route with immutable route evidence
immutable, independently qualified operation causal-route anchor
CAPITAL_CONTINUITY_CAUSAL_ROUTE_V1 qualified against that immutable anchor

lineage.lineage_gap_result: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or REJECT by positive contradiction; never ADMIT

selected_upstream.definition: immutable route {pool, coordinator, distribution, pool_signature, upper_signature, times, amounts} identified by a digest

capital_continuity.qualified_definition: assessor-proven candidate (pool, coordinator) exactly equals an independently retained, immutable canonical causal-route anchor
capital_continuity.current_problem: operation_route_anchors currently enumerates operator_launch_membership and recomputes anchors from those mutable canonical rows. That is useful read-only context but cannot satisfy this V2 input contract's noncircular immutable-anchor requirement.

ordering.required_semantics: Parent causal event must precede child: authoritative different-slot comparison is sufficient; equal slots require a qualified transaction ordinal; block time and signature order are not substitutes.
ordering.different_slot_rule: QUALIFIED only where compact authoritative parent and child slots prove parent before child
ordering.current_problem: Current Deep review routes retain block times and signatures but not compact parent/child slot records or transaction ordinals.

negative_controls.missing_evidence_control: Any missing required immutable identity, anchor, slot, or ordinal returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never ADMIT.
negative_controls.unknown_root_control: Unknown root is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not automatically a conflict; it still cannot ADMIT without the positive immutable-anchor requirement.

candidate_policy_v2.candidate_only_not_qualified_for_impleme: ADMIT iff every required immutable input/result in candidate_v2_input_contract is present and qualified. REJECT only for a positive contradiction/conflict. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for missing/unknown/unqualified required evidence. REVIEW is retained for strong nonconflicting evidence that falls short of the automatic conjunction.
